# Edraw.AI

> Edraw.AI is an AI-powered visual collaboration platform offering 40+ tools for diagramming, design, and team productivity.

Edraw.AI provides an all-in-one suite of online tools for creating flowcharts, diagrams, presentations, and design projects with AI assistance. The platform emphasizes real-time team collaboration, extensive export options (PDF, PNG, SVG, Visio, Word, Excel), and free access to core features with premium trials available.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered diagramming
- Visual collaboration
- Real-time editing
- Team collaboration
- Flowchart maker
- Project management
- Mind mapping
- Presentation maker
- Whiteboard tool
- Export formats (PDF, PNG, SVG, Visio)
- Design templates
- Free online tools
- AI chat assistance
- Diagram templates
- EdrawMax
